news.zh: TARIC 10-29 快照：Q3 未用的 77.8 万吨已结转入 Q4，Q4 可用总量升至 536.4 万吨，已用 46.1%，较 10-27 多用 4.6 万吨；14 个已用尽订单号因结转重获余额（中国螺纹钢 09.9888 回到 4,727 吨），用尽 53 个，临界 26 个
news.en: TARIC 29 Oct snapshot: the unused 778 kt of Q3 has been carried into Q4, lifting Q4 to 5.36 Mt, now 46.1% used, with another 46.1 kt drawn since 27 Oct; 14 exhausted orders reopened on the carry-over (China rebar 09.9888 is back to 4,727 t); 53 orders exhausted, 26 critical

news.zh: TARIC 10-27 快照：Q4 已用 52.9%，较 10-23 多用 4.9 万吨；用尽 65 个（新增 3 个），临界 16 个；中国螺纹钢 09.9888 用掉 4,995 吨，仅剩 35 吨；越南镀层板 09.9832 用掉 8,231 吨。Q3 结算中剩余 77.8 万吨，10-28 停止分配
news.en: TARIC 27 Oct snapshot: Q4 is 52.9% used, with another 49.1 kt drawn since 23 Oct; 65 orders exhausted (3 new) and 16 critical; China rebar 09.9888 drew 5.0 kt and is down to 35 t; Vietnam coated sheet 09.9832 drew 8.2 kt. Q3 (settling) has 778 kt left; allocation stops 28 Oct

news.zh: TARIC 10-23 快照：Q4 已用 51.8%，较 10-22 多用 1.9 万吨；用尽 62 个（新增 09.9607 其他国家有机涂层板），临界 14 个；土耳其镀锡板 09.9851 用掉 4,000 吨，09.9629 其他国家非合金钢丝仅剩 15 吨。Q3 剩 77.8 万吨，10-28 停止分配
news.en: TARIC 23 Oct snapshot: Q4 is 51.8% used, with another 19.5 kt drawn since 22 Oct; 62 orders exhausted (new: 09.9607 other-countries organic-coated sheet) and 14 critical; Türkiye tinplate 09.9851 drew 4.0 kt, and other-countries non-alloy wire 09.9629 is down to 15 t. Q3 (settling) has 778 kt left; allocation stops 28 Oct

news.zh: TARIC 10-22 快照：Q4 已用 51.4%，较 10-20 多用 9.2 万吨；用尽 61 个（新增中国棒材及轻型材 09.9878、土耳其非合金钢丝 09.9954 等 3 个，退回恢复 1 个），临界 14 个；韩国中厚板 09.9854 用掉 2.1 万吨。Q3 剩 77.8 万吨，10-28 停止分配
news.en: TARIC 22 Oct snapshot: Q4 is now 51.4% used, with another 92.3 kt drawn since 20 Oct; 61 orders exhausted (3 new, incl. China merchant bars 09.9878 and Türkiye non-alloy wire 09.9954; 1 reopened after a return) and 14 critical; Korea quarto plate 09.9854 drew 20.9 kt. Q3 (settling) has 778 kt left; allocation stops 28 Oct

news.zh: TARIC 10-20 快照：Q4 占用率 49.4%，较 10-16 再用掉 5.8 万吨；已用尽 59 个（新增 5 个，含 09.9606 其他国家镀层板、09.9707 FTA–其他国家冷轧），临界 14 个；印度冷轧 09.9818 用掉 9,252 吨。Q3 结算中剩余 77.8 万吨，10-28 停止分配
news.en: TARIC 20 Oct snapshot: Q4 is 49.4% used, with another 58.0 kt drawn since 16 Oct; 59 orders exhausted (5 new, incl. 09.9606 other-countries coated sheet, 09.9611 other-countries stainless CR sheet and 09.9707 FTA–other CRC) and 14 critical; India CRC 09.9818 drew 9.3 kt. Q3 (settling) has 778 kt left; allocation stops 28 Oct
